l4_steps.name: Obtain ATIS & meteorological briefing
l4_steps.input: Scheduled departure time, origin/destination airport pair
l4_steps.output: Current ATIS information code, wx briefing package
l4_steps.kpi: Briefing completed ≥45 min before STD; 100% crew acknowledgement rate
l4_steps.pain_point: GoDirect ATIS latency can lag live tower broadcasts by 3–5 min during high-volume periods, risking crew departure on stale altimeter settings

l4_steps.name: File IFR flight plan with ANSP
l4_steps.input: Optimised route, fuel load, aircraft type, SELCAL code
l4_steps.output: Filed ICAO flight plan (FPL message) accepted by ANSP
l4_steps.kpi: Flight plan filed ≥60 min before STD per ICAO Doc 4444; acceptance rate ≥99%
l4_steps.pain_point: NAVBLUE route optimisation does not automatically incorporate FAA Coded Departure Routes (CDRs) during Ground Delay Programs, requiring manual dispatcher override

l4_steps.name: Request CTOT/EDCT slot from ATFM system
l4_steps.input: Filed flight plan, GDP/GS advisory for destination or en-route ARTCC
l4_steps.output: EDCT (Expect Departure Clearance Time) slot assignment
l4_steps.kpi: EDCT compliance rate ≥95%; slot deviation window ±5 min
l4_steps.pain_point: TFMS EDCT updates can arrive with <15 min notice, making ground crew coordination nearly impossible during high-frequency departure banks at focus cities

l4_steps.name: Negotiate revised slot if CTOT unacceptable
l4_steps.input: Initial EDCT that conflicts with operational constraints or crew duty limits
l4_steps.output: Revised EDCT or cancellation/delay decision logged in NAVBLUE
l4_steps.kpi: Slot substitution request processed within 10 min of receipt; substitution approval rate ~60% per FAA ATCSCC data
l4_steps.pain_point: FAA does not guarantee slot substitution approval; carriers without dedicated ATC coordination desk (like low-cost carriers) suffer higher rejection rates

l4_steps.name: Request IFR departure clearance from ATC
l4_steps.input: Filed route, EDCT window, current ATIS code
l4_steps.output: ATC clearance (SID, squawk code, initial altitude, departure frequency)
l4_steps.kpi: Clearance received ≥15 min before EDCT; clearance readback accuracy 100%
l4_steps.pain_point: Voice clearance delivery congestion at Class B airports (ORD, ATL, LAX) causes average 8–12 min clearance delays during push banks; PDC via ACARS not universally available

l4_steps.name: Verify clearance against filed route & amend if needed
l4_steps.input: Received ATC clearance text, original filed IFR route
l4_steps.output: Amended flight plan accepted by ATC or confirmation of route match
l4_steps.kpi: Route amendment turnaround <5 min; zero departures on unapproved route
l4_steps.pain_point: ATC short-notice route amendments (e.g. miles-in-trail restrictions) require rapid NAVBLUE recalculation that may invalidate pre-filed fuel load, triggering re-release

l4_steps.name: Coordinate pushback & engine start with ground ATC
l4_steps.input: Approved clearance, gate status from AMS, ramp clearance
l4_steps.output: Pushback approval, engine start time logged in AMS
l4_steps.kpi: Pushback-to-wheels-up compliance with EDCT ±5 min; gate conflict rate <2%
l4_steps.pain_point: AMS gate conflict data and ATC ground movement frequency are separate systems with no real-time integration, causing dispatcher blind spots during congested apron operations

l4_steps.name: Obtain taxi clearance & confirm runway assignment
l4_steps.input: Engine start confirmation, active runways, NOTAMs from FliteDeck
l4_steps.output: Taxi route confirmed on EFB moving map; runway assignment accepted
l4_steps.kpi: Taxi time within airline benchmark (e.g. ≤12 min at focus cities); runway incursion events = 0
l4_steps.pain_point: FliteDeck moving-map airport diagrams rely on Jeppesen chart update cycle (28-day AIRAC); temporary construction NOTAMs between cycles create taxiway routing errors if crew relies solely on EFB

l4_steps.name: Monitor ATC sector handoffs & frequency changes
l4_steps.input: Departure from origin TRACON, en-route ARTCC sector list from NAVBLUE
l4_steps.output: ACARS position reports at waypoints; sector contact log
l4_steps.kpi: ACARS position report every 30 min or at each waypoint; missed report alert <2 min
l4_steps.pain_point: ACARS coverage gaps over oceanic/remote segments require HF radio fallback (SELCAL), which many newer pilots have limited proficiency with due to shift away from HF in domestic ops

l4_steps.name: Receive & assess TFMS en-route flow advisories
l4_steps.input: En-route Miles-in-Trail (MIT) restrictions, Airspace Flow Program (AFP) advisories
l4_steps.output: Compliance assessment; amended release or hold action if needed
l4_steps.kpi: AFP compliance rate ≥97%; dispatcher response to advisory <10 min
l4_steps.pain_point: TFMS AFP advisories can affect multiple concurrent flights simultaneously; single dispatcher managing 15+ flights during an AFP event is a documented overload risk with no automated prioritisation tool

l4_steps.name: Coordinate weather deviation or reroute with ATC
l4_steps.input: Onboard weather radar data, GoDirect TurbCast/convective sigmets
l4_steps.output: ATC-approved route deviation or altitude change; updated NAVBLUE flight plan
l4_steps.kpi: Deviation request approval by ATC <3 min after pilot request; fuel impact assessed 100% of deviations
l4_steps.pain_point: Crew-initiated deviation requests during congested sector workload may receive delayed ATC responses; no automated conflict-free re-route suggestion pushed from ground to cockpit in real time

l4_steps.name: Obtain destination ATIS & update approach briefing
l4_steps.input: Current destination ATIS (D-ATIS), TAF, PIREP data from GoDirect
l4_steps.output: Updated approach briefing; alternate airport confirmed if wx below minima
l4_steps.kpi: ATIS update obtained ≥30 min before TOD; alternate fuel carried 100% when wx within 3h of approach minima
l4_steps.pain_point: D-ATIS refresh intervals (30 min at many airports) can lag rapidly deteriorating convective conditions, creating a wx state mismatch between briefing and actual approach environment

l4_steps.name: Sequence into STAR & configure for arrival flow
l4_steps.input: ATC-assigned STAR, speed/altitude restrictions, runway in use
l4_steps.output: FMS programmed with STAR; compliance with ATC sequence instructions confirmed
l4_steps.kpi: STAR compliance rate ≥99%; speed restriction deviation events <0.5% of arrivals
l4_steps.pain_point: Late STAR reassignments by TRACON (within 50 NM) require rapid FMS re-programming under high workload; FliteDeck chart page and FMS are not electronically linked, requiring dual cross-check

l4_steps.name: Execute holding pattern if ATC flow delay required
l4_steps.input: ATC holding instruction, current fuel state vs NAVBLUE holding fuel reserves
l4_steps.output: Holding entry flown or divert decision made; dispatcher notified of fuel state
l4_steps.kpi: Holding fuel contingency ≥30 min per FAR 121.639; divert decision made before minimum divert fuel threshold
l4_steps.pain_point: NAVBLUE fuel models do not auto-recalculate holding burn in real time from cockpit; dispatcher relies on crew verbal reports, introducing latency risk in marginal fuel scenarios

l4_steps.name: Coordinate gate & stand assignment with airport ops
l4_steps.input: ETA update from ACARS, gate availability from AMS, inbound connection data
l4_steps.output: Confirmed gate assignment published in AMS; ground handling notified
l4_steps.kpi: Gate assignment confirmed ≥20 min before ETA; gate conflict rate <1%
l4_steps.pain_point: ATC arrival sequencing changes (e.g. runway change) can shift ETA by 10–20 min, invalidating pre-assigned gate in AMS; no automated ATC-to-AMS ETA feed at most regional airports

l4_steps.name: Close flight plan & confirm arrival report
l4_steps.input: Block-in time from AMS, ATC arrival message
l4_steps.output: Flight plan closed in NAVBLUE; OOOI times recorded (Out/Off/On/In)
l4_steps.kpi: Flight plan closure within 5 min of block-in; OOOI data accuracy 100%
l4_steps.pain_point: Manual flight plan closure is required when ATC arrival message (ARR) is not auto-forwarded to NAVBLUE; missed closures generate ATC search-and-rescue alerts after 30 min per ICAO Annex 2

l4_steps.name: Review ATC communications log for deviations
l4_steps.input: ACARS message archive, crew debrief notes
l4_steps.output: Deviation log entry; flag for ASAP review if applicable
l4_steps.kpi: Post-flight review completed within 2 hours of block-in for all flagged flights
l4_steps.pain_point: ACARS stores text messages but does not archive voice ATC transmissions; voice deviations are entirely reliant on crew self-report, creating an underreporting risk for FAR Part 91/121 deviations

l4_steps.name: File ASAP/MOR report for ATC deviation or incident
l4_steps.input: Deviation flag from step 5.2, crew narrative, ATC incident reference number
l4_steps.output: ASAP report submitted to airline safety program; MOR filed with ANSP if required
l4_steps.kpi: ASAP report filed within 24 hours of incident per FAA AC 120-66B; 100% of flagged deviations reported
l4_steps.pain_point: No direct integration between NAVBLUE deviation logs and the airline ASAP reporting portal; dispatcher must re-enter data manually, creating transcription errors and reporting delays
